about: fieldnotes' mutants (wf10 SSR WEB2): edits of the example's packages and of modules/web that its laws, tests and cases must kill (examples:fieldnotes runs them all); each rule names its killer. Run with go run ./scripts/mutants ./examples/fieldnotes.

mutants.name: fieldnotes-feed-title-unescaped
mutants.rule: A feed's title is escaped XML text (law FeedIsWellFormed; the print case).

mutants.name: fieldnotes-entry-link-unescaped
mutants.rule: An entry's link writes its title as text (the print case, whose title holds <marsh>).

mutants.name: fieldnotes-feed-not-listed
mutants.rule: The build lists every page (law EveryPageIsListed; the build and print cases).

mutants.name: fieldnotes-feed-other-host
mutants.rule: A route's link parses back to it; //feed.xml is printed as another path (law HrefParses, the link form; web.Routes' HrefParses still holds).

mutants.name: fieldnotes-slug-keeps-case
mutants.from: let lower = if c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' { c + ('a' - 'A') } else { c }
mutants.rule: A slug is lower case: a title in upper case has the same slug (law SlugIsItsOwn only).

mutants.name: fieldnotes-paragraph-line-dropped
mutants.rule: Each body line is read into its paragraph (law FormatThenRead; the print case).

mutants.name: nou-end-loses-result
mutants.rule: Generic Reader sends the accumulated entry on End, including an unterminated paragraph. The direct Read law cannot see an adapter that silently stays instead of finishing.

mutants.name: nou-step-suppresses-reject
mutants.from: BadLine{No: l.No, Reason: "unknown key " + strings.TrimSpace(h.Before) + "; want title, day or related"}
mutants.rule: Ordinary lines still report an unknown head key as BadLine with its original line number.

mutants.name: fieldnotes-day-shape
mutants.rule: A day is YYYY-MM-DD (BadNotesSayWhere; the bad-note case).

mutants.name: fieldnotes-memory-read-other
mutants.rule: Read gives the entry of its slug (law Journal.ListedEntriesRead).

mutants.name: web2-build-no-folders
mutants.rule: Build makes the folders a file needs (BuildWritesWhatPrintPrints; the build case).
